name: Meditate with the tables of chartres
summary:
Practice the Tables of Chartres in virtual reality.

The circle, the square and the rectangle: three simple shapes that make up a meditative practice for focus and inner calm. Soften your gaze until the shapes merge into one, and let your mind settle.

Features
• A guided introduction teaches the technique step by step
• Peaceful environments, from island beaches and starry nights to mountain summits, a painted valley and outer space
• Passthrough mode: practice with the shapes floating in your own room
